question.zh-CN: 机器人服务于哪些工作流程，价值如何通过真实任务衡量？
question.en: Which workflows do robots serve, and how is value measured through real tasks?

problem.zh-CN: 完成取放、装配、检测与加工工序。
problem.en: Perform handling, assembly, inspection and processing.

research.zh-CN: 接触丰富操作、柔性工件与技能组合。
research.en: Contact-rich manipulation, deformable parts and skill composition.

industry.en: Tooling, quality, cycle time and changeovers.

compare.zh-CN: 良率、节拍、换型成本与人工介入。
compare.en: Yield, cycle time, changeover cost and interventions.

problem.zh-CN: 连接存储、分拣、搬运与交付。
problem.en: Connect storage, sorting, transport and handoff.

research.zh-CN: 移动操作、多机协同与动态规划。
research.en: Mobile manipulation, multi-robot coordination and dynamic planning.

industry.zh-CN: 设施对接、拥堵、峰值负载与运营维护。
industry.en: Facility integration, congestion, peak loads and service.

compare.zh-CN: 吞吐、订单完成率、接管与停机。
compare.en: Throughput, order completion, takeover and downtime.

problem.zh-CN: 完成清洁、配送、接待等日常服务。
problem.en: Perform cleaning, delivery, reception and routine services.

research.zh-CN: 社会导航、人机交互与任务切换。
research.en: Social navigation, human interaction and task switching.

industry.zh-CN: 楼宇权限、人员混行与服务流程。
industry.en: Building access, shared spaces and service workflows.

compare.zh-CN: 服务完成率、覆盖率与用户介入。
compare.en: Service completion, coverage and user intervention.

problem.zh-CN: 适应非结构化家庭及不同用户。
problem.en: Adapt to unstructured homes and varied users.

research.zh-CN: 常识、个性化、开放物体与长期记忆。
research.en: Commonsense, personalization, open objects and long-term memory.

industry.zh-CN: 易用性、成本、隐私与持续支持。
industry.en: Usability, cost, privacy and continued support.

compare.zh-CN: 真实家庭任务、故障率与维护负担。
compare.en: Real household tasks, failures and maintenance burden.

name.en: Energy, agriculture and specialized field work

problem.zh-CN: 在复杂或危险环境中感知和作业。
problem.en: Sense and act in complex or hazardous environments.

research.zh-CN: 越障、目标识别与环境适应。
research.en: Obstacle traversal, target recognition and environmental adaptation.

industry.zh-CN: 防护、通信、任务载荷与远程操作。
industry.en: Protection, communication, mission payloads and remote operation.

compare.zh-CN: 任务覆盖、环境边界与救援恢复。
compare.en: Mission coverage, environmental envelope and retrieval or recovery.

problem.zh-CN: 在人的身体与临床工作流中提供辅助。
problem.en: Provide assistance around human bodies and clinical workflows.

research.zh-CN: 人机耦合、精密控制与个体适配。
research.en: Human-robot coupling, precision control and personalization.

industry.zh-CN: 使用条件、临床验证、维护与专业培训。
industry.en: Conditions of use, clinical validation, service and specialist training.

compare.zh-CN: 任务精度、使用边界与特定场景验证。
compare.en: Task accuracy, use boundaries and setting-specific validation.
